sentences.zh: 離親舊、去鄉邑，豈人情之所樂哉。

translations.literal: To leave kin and old friends and depart one's home district—how could that be what human feeling delights in?
translations.idiomatic: To leave kin and home—what man would choose that willingly?

sentences.zh: 僕雖偷生寄食他國，首丘之念，未嘗一日忘之。

translations.literal: Though your servant steals life and lives on another state's bounty, the thought of returning to the mound of my ancestors has not been forgotten for a single day.
translations.idiomatic: Though I live on borrowed time in a foreign land, I have not forgotten for a single day my wish to return home.

sentences.zh: 如朝廷赦青之罪，乞假邳州以屯老幼。

translations.literal: If the court pardons Qing's crimes, I beg to be lent Pizhou to settle the old and young.
translations.idiomatic: If the court pardons my crimes, I beg leave to station my family at Pizhou.

sentences.zh: 當襲取盱眙，盡定淮南，以贖往昔之過。」

translations.literal: I shall strike and take Xuyi, settle all Huainan, and thereby redeem my past faults."
translations.idiomatic: I will strike Xuyi, pacify all Huainan, and atone for my past faults."

sentences.zh: 牙吾塔複書曰：「公等初亦無罪，誠能為國建功，全軍來歸，即吾人也。

translations.literal: Yayuta replied in a letter: "You were originally without guilt; if you can truly render merit to the state and bring your whole army back in submission, you will be one of us.
translations.idiomatic: Yayuta replied: "You were never guilty in the first place. If you truly serve the state and bring your whole army home, you will be one of us.

sentences.zh: 邳州吾城，以吾人居之，亦何不可。

translations.literal: Pizhou is my city—what harm if my people dwell there?
translations.idiomatic: Pizhou is my city. What harm if your people dwell there?

sentences.zh: 《易》曰：'君子見幾而作，不俟終日。

translations.literal: The Changes says: 'The noble man, seeing the first sign, acts and does not wait for the full day.'
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Changes says: 'When the noble man sees the first sign, he acts and does not wait for the full day.'

sentences.zh: '公其亟圖之。

translations.literal: Sir, plan this quickly.
translations.idiomatic: Plan this quickly.

sentences.zh: 生還父母之邦，富貴終身，傳芳後世，與其羈縻異域，目以兵虜，孰愈哉？」

translations.literal: To return alive to the land of your parents, enjoy wealth and honor for life, and leave fragrance to later generations—compared with being held in an alien region and regarded as a captive soldier, which is better?"
translations.idiomatic: To return alive to your homeland, enjoy wealth and honor for life, and leave a good name to posterity—is that not better than being held in a foreign land and treated as a captive soldier?"

sentences.zh: 牙吾塔奏其事。

translations.literal: Yayuta memorialized the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Yayuta memorialized the exchange to the court.

sentences.zh: 十月，詔加青銀青榮祿大夫，封滕陽公，仍為本處兵馬總領元帥、兼宣撫使。

translations.literal: In the tenth month an edict added to Qing the title Silver-Green Grand Master for Glorious Blessing, enfeoffed him as Duke of Tengyang, and retained him as supreme commander of local troops and horses and concurrently pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month an edict promoted Qing to Silver-Green Grand Master for Glorious Blessing, enfeoffed him as Duke of Tengyang, and named him supreme commander of local forces and concurrently pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 青潛表陳謝，複以邳州為請。

translations.literal: Qing secretly submitted a memorial of thanks and again requested Pizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Qing secretly submitted a memorial of thanks and again asked for Pizhou.

sentences.zh: 樞密院奏：「恐青意止欲得邳州。

translations.literal: The Privy Council memorialized: "I fear Qing's intent is only to obtain Pizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Privy Council reported: "We fear Qing's only aim is to obtain Pizhou.

sentences.zh: 可諭牙吾塔，若青誠實來歸，即當授之。

translations.literal: Yayuta may be instructed that if Qing sincerely comes back in submission, it should then be granted to him.
translations.idiomatic: Yayuta should be told that if Qing returns in good faith, Pizhou will be granted to him.

sentences.zh: 如審其詐，可使人入宋境宣佈往來之言，及所援官爵，亦行間之術也。」

translations.literal: If his deceit is verified, a man may be sent into Song territory to proclaim the exchanges and the official ranks granted him—this too is a stratagem of sowing discord."
translations.idiomatic: If he proves treacherous, send men into Song territory to spread word of these exchanges and the ranks granted him—that too is a stratagem of sowing discord."

sentences.zh: 青既不得邳州，複為宋守。

translations.literal: Since Qing did not obtain Pizhou, he again served as Song defender.
translations.idiomatic: When Qing failed to obtain Pizhou, he remained in Song service.

sentences.zh: 興定五年正月二十五日夜，青襲破泗州西城，提控王祿遇害。

translations.literal: On the night of the twenty-fifth day of the first month of the fifth year of Xingding, Qing raided and broke Sizhou's western city; commander Wang Lu was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the twenty-fifth of the first month of Xingding 5, Qing stormed and took Sizhou's western city. Commander Wang Lu was killed.

sentences.zh: 是時，時全為同簽樞密院事，朝廷不知青襲破西城，止稱宋人而已。

translations.literal: At that time Shi Quan was co-signatory of the Privy Council; the court did not know Qing had raided and broken the western city and spoke only of Song men.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Quan was then co-signatory of the Privy Council. The court did not know Qing had taken the western city and reported only that Song troops were responsible.

sentences.zh: 詔全往督泗州兵取西城。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Quan to go and supervise Sizhou troops in retaking the western city.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Quan to supervise the Sizhou garrison in retaking the western city.

sentences.zh: 全至泗州，獲紅祆賊一人，詰問之，乃知青為宋京東鈐轄，襲破西城。

translations.literal: When Quan reached Sizhou he captured one Red Scarves bandit and interrogated him, learning that Qing was Song eastern Hebei commander and had raided and broken the western city.
translations.idiomatic: When Quan reached Sizhou he captured a Red Scarves bandit and learned under questioning that Qing was Song eastern Hebei commander and had taken the western city.

sentences.zh: 全頗喜，乃殺其人以滅口。

translations.literal: Quan was rather pleased and killed the man to silence him.
translations.idiomatic: Quan was pleased and killed the man to silence him.

sentences.zh: 牙吾塔晝夜力戰，募死士以梯沖逼城，青縋兵出拒不得前。

translations.literal: Yayuta fought day and night with all his strength, recruited dare-to-die men to press the walls with ladders and rams, but Qing lowered troops by rope to repel them and they could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Yayuta fought day and night, recruited dare-to-die men to assault the walls with ladders and rams, but Qing lowered troops by rope to repel them and they could not advance.

sentences.zh: 牙吾塔遣提控王應孫穴城，東北隅，青夜出兵來襲，擊卻之。

translations.literal: Yayuta sent commander Wang Yingsun to tunnel into the city at the northeast corner; Qing sent troops out by night to strike and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: Yayuta sent Commander Wang Yingsun to tunnel into the northeast corner of the city. Qing sallied by night and drove him back.

sentences.zh: 越二日，複出又卻之。

translations.literal: After two days he came out again and was again repelled.
translations.idiomatic: Two days later he tried again and was repelled once more.

sentences.zh: 攻城益急，青以舟兵二千合城中兵來犯牙吾塔營，提控斡魯朵先知，設伏掩擊，青兵大敗，溺淮水死者千人，自是不復出矣。

translations.literal: The assault on the city grew still fiercer; Qing with two thousand boat troops joined the city garrison to attack Yayuta's camp; commander Woluduo foreknew it and set an ambush; Qing's troops were greatly defeated and a thousand drowned in the Huai; from then on he did not come out again.
translations.idiomatic: The assault intensified. Qing sent two thousand boat troops with the city garrison against Yayuta's camp. Commander Woluduo anticipated the move and ambushed them. Qing's force was routed and a thousand men drowned in the Huai. After that he did not sally again.

sentences.zh: 王應孫穴城將及城中，青隧地然薪，逼出之。

translations.literal: Wang Yingsun's tunnel was about to reach inside the city; Qing tunneled in turn, set fuel alight underground, and forced them out.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yingsun's tunnel was nearly inside the walls when Qing counter-tunneled, set fires underground, and forced the miners out.

sentences.zh: 青乘城指麾，流矢中其目，餘眾往往被創，樓堞相繼摧壞，城中恟懼，遂無固志。

translations.literal: Qing mounted the wall to direct operations; a stray arrow struck his eye; many of the rest were wounded; towers and parapets were destroyed one after another; panic spread in the city and there was no longer a will to hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: Qing mounted the wall to direct the defense. A stray arrow struck his eye. Many of his men were wounded and the towers and parapets crumbled one after another. Panic spread through the city and the will to resist collapsed.

sentences.zh: 二月二十六日夜，青拔眾走，遂複西城。

translations.literal: On the night of the twenty-sixth day of the second month Qing withdrew his force and fled; the western city was then recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the twenty-sixth of the second month Qing withdrew and fled. The western city was recovered.

sentences.zh: 元光元年二月，全與元帥左監軍訛可，節制三路軍馬伐宋。

translations.literal: In the second month of the first year of Yuanguang, Quan and Marshal Left Vice Commissioner Eke took command of the three-route armies to attack the Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of Yuanguang, Quan and Marshal Left Vice Commissioner Eke took command of the three-route armies to attack the Song.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「卿等重任，毋致不和，以貽喪敗。

translations.literal: An edict said: "You bear heavy responsibilities; do not let discord arise and bring defeat.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "You bear heavy responsibilities; do not let discord arise and bring defeat.

sentences.zh: 其資糧可取，規取失宜不能得之，罪在訛可，既已得之，不能運致以為我用，罪在全。」

translations.literal: Supplies may be taken—if the plan for taking them is unsuitable and they cannot be obtained, the fault lies with Eke; once obtained, if they cannot be transported for our use, the fault lies with Quan."
translations.idiomatic: Supplies may be taken—if the plan for taking them is unsuitable and they cannot be obtained, the fault lies with Eke; once obtained, if they cannot be transported for our use, the fault lies with Quan."

sentences.zh: 全與訛可由潁、壽進渡淮，敗宋人于高塘市，攻固始縣，破宋廬州將焦思忠兵。

translations.literal: Quan and Eke advanced from Ying and Shou to cross the Huai, defeated Song troops at Gaotang Market, attacked Gushi County, and routed the Song Luzhou commander Jiao Sizhong's force.
translations.idiomatic: Quan and Eke advanced from Ying and Shou to cross the Huai, defeated Song troops at Gaotang Market, attacked Gushi County, and routed the Song Luzhou commander Jiao Sizhong's force.

sentences.zh: 無何，獲生口言，時青受宋詔，與全兵相拒，全匿其事。

translations.literal: Before long captives reported that Shi Qing had received a Song commission and was opposing Quan's army; Quan concealed the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Before long captives reported that Shi Qing had received a Song commission and was opposing Quan's army; Quan concealed the matter.

sentences.zh: 五月，兵還，距淮二十里，諸軍將渡，全矯稱密詔「諸軍且留收淮南麥」，遂下令人獲麥三石以給軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the army returned; twenty li from the Huai the various armies were about to cross; Quan falsely claimed a secret edict: "The armies are to remain and harvest Huainan wheat," and then ordered each man to gather three piculs of wheat to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the army withdrew. Twenty li from the Huai, as the troops were about to cross, Quan forged a secret edict: "The armies shall remain to harvest Huainan wheat," and ordered each man to gather three piculs of wheat for the army.

sentences.zh: 眾惑之，訛可及諸將佐勸之不聽，軍留三日。

translations.literal: The troops were perplexed; Eke and the generals and staff urged him but he would not listen, and the army remained three days.
translations.idiomatic: The troops were perplexed. Eke and the other generals urged him to move on, but he refused, and the army stayed three days.

sentences.zh: 訛可謂全曰：「今淮水淺狹，可以速濟。

translations.literal: Eke said to Quan: "The Huai is now shallow and narrow and can be crossed quickly.
translations.idiomatic: Eke said to Quan: "The Huai is shallow and narrow now. We can cross quickly.

sentences.zh: 時方暑雨，若值暴漲，宋乘其後，將不得完歸矣。」

translations.literal: It is the season of summer rains; if a sudden flood comes and the Song strike from behind, the army will not be able to return intact."
translations.idiomatic: It is the season of summer rains. If a sudden flood comes and the Song strike from behind, we will not get the army home intact."

sentences.zh: 全力拒之。

translations.literal: Quan firmly refused.
translations.idiomatic: Quan firmly refused.

sentences.zh: 從宜達阿、移失不、斜烈、李辛稍稍不平，全怒曰：「訛可一帥耳，汝曹黨之。

translations.literal: Congyi Da'a, Yishibu, Xielie, and Li Xin were somewhat discontented; Quan said angrily: "Eke is only one commander—you lot are his faction.
translations.idiomatic: Congyi Da'a, Yishibu, Xielie, and Li Xin grew restive. Quan said angrily: "Eke is only one commander—you are all in his faction.

sentences.zh: 汝曹致身至此，皆吾之力。

translations.literal: You have risen to where you are entirely through my power.
translations.idiomatic: You owe your positions entirely to me.

sentences.zh: 吾院官也，於汝無不可者。」

translations.literal: I am a Privy Council officer—there is nothing I may not do to you."
translations.idiomatic: I am a Privy Council officer. There is nothing I may not do to you."

sentences.zh: 眾乃不敢言。

translations.literal: The crowd then dared not speak.
translations.idiomatic: No one dared speak again.

sentences.zh: 是夜，大雨。

translations.literal: That night there was heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: That night heavy rain fell.

sentences.zh: 明日，淮水暴漲，乃為橋渡軍。

translations.literal: The next day the Huai rose in flood; they then built a bridge to cross the army.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the Huai flooded. They built a bridge to get the army across.

sentences.zh: 宋兵襲之，軍遂敗績。

translations.literal: Song troops struck them and the army was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Song troops struck and the army was routed.

sentences.zh: 橋壞，全以輕舟先濟，士卒皆覆沒。

translations.literal: The bridge broke; Quan crossed first in a light boat and the soldiers were all drowned.
translations.idiomatic: The bridge collapsed. Quan escaped in a light boat while the soldiers were drowned.

sentences.zh: 宣宗乃下詔誅之，遣官招集潰軍，詔曰：「大軍渡淮，每立功效。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong then issued an edict condemning him and sent officials to gather the scattered troops; the edict said: "The great army crossed the Huai and repeatedly achieved merit.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong issued an edict condemning Quan and sent officials to gather the scattered troops. The edict read: "The great army crossed the Huai and repeatedly achieved merit.

sentences.zh: 諸將謬誤，部曲散亡，流離憂苦，朕甚閔焉。

translations.literal: The generals erred, the units scattered and perished, and the men wander in distress—I am deeply grieved.
translations.idiomatic: The generals erred. Units scattered and men wander in distress. We are deeply grieved.

sentences.zh: 各歸舊營，勉圖自效。」

translations.literal: Each shall return to his old camp and strive to serve effectively."
translations.idiomatic: Return to your old camps and strive to serve again."

sentences.zh: 又詔曰：「陣亡把軍品官子孫，十五以上者依品官子孫例隨局承應，十五以下、十歲以上者依品從隨局給俸，至成人本局差使。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "For descendants of company officers of rank who died in battle: those fifteen and above shall follow the precedent for descendants of ranked officers and serve in the bureau; those below fifteen and ten or above shall receive salaries according to rank in the bureau until adulthood, when the home bureau assigns duties.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict said: "For descendants of ranked company officers killed in battle: those fifteen and above shall enter bureau service under the precedent for officers' descendants; those between ten and fifteen shall receive salaries according to rank until adulthood, when the home bureau assigns duties.

sentences.zh: 無子孫官，依例給俸。

translations.literal: For officers without descendants, salaries shall be given according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: For officers without descendants, salaries shall be paid according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 應贈官、賻錢、軍人家口當養贍者。

translations.literal: Posthumous ranks, funeral money, and support for soldiers' families shall all follow the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous ranks, funeral payments, and support for soldiers' families shall follow the old regulations.

sentences.zh: 並如舊制。」

translations.literal: All shall be as under the former system."
translations.idiomatic: All shall follow the former system."

sentences.zh: 贊曰：金自章宗季年，宋韓侂胄構難，招誘鄰境亡命以撓中原，事竟無成。

translations.literal: The encomium says: From the late years of Emperor Zhangzong of Jin, when the Song's Han Tuozhou stirred up trouble and recruited fugitives from neighboring territories to harass the central plain, the affair in the end came to nothing.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium says: From the late years of Emperor Zhangzong, when the Song minister Han Tuozhou stirred up war and recruited fugitives from neighboring territories to harass the central plain, the affair came to nothing.

sentences.zh: 而青、徐、淮海之郊民心一搖，歲遇饑饉，盜賊蜂起，相為長雄，又自屠滅，害及無辜，十餘年糜沸未息。

translations.literal: Yet in the borderlands of Qing, Xu, and the Huai-Hai the people's hearts were shaken at once; year after year famine came; bandits rose like bees; they made one another chieftains and then slaughtered one another; harm reached the innocent; for more than ten years turmoil boiled without ceasing.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in Qing, Xu, and the Huai-Hai borderlands popular loyalty wavered. Famine followed famine. Bandits rose in swarms, made one another chieftains, and slaughtered one another. Innocents suffered. For more than ten years the region seethed without rest.

sentences.zh: 宣宗不思靖難，複為伐宋之舉，迄金之亡，其禍尤甚。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuanzong did not think of quelling the disorders but again undertook an expedition against the Song; down to the Jin's fall the calamity was still greater.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuanzong did not seek to quell the disorders but launched another campaign against the Song. Down to the fall of Jin the calamity only grew worse.

sentences.zh: 簡書所載國用安、時青等遺事，至今仁人君子讀之猶蹙頞終日。

translations.literal: The surviving accounts of Guo Yong'an, Shi Qing, and the like recorded in the annals still make humane gentlemen knit their brows for a whole day when they read them.
translations.idiomatic: The surviving accounts of Guo Yong'an, Shi Qing, and men like them still make humane readers knit their brows for a whole day.

sentences.zh: 當時烝黎，如魚在釜，其何以自存乎。

translations.literal: The common people of that time were like fish in a cauldron—how could they preserve themselves?
translations.idiomatic: The common people of that time were like fish in a boiling pot. How could they survive?

sentences.zh: 兵，兇器也。

translations.literal: Arms are an instrument of ill omen.
translations.idiomatic: Arms are instruments of ill omen.

sentences.zh: 金以兵得國，亦以兵失國，可不慎哉，可不慎哉！

translations.literal: Jin gained the realm through arms and also lost the realm through arms—how can one not be cautious, how can one not be cautious!
translations.idiomatic: Jin won the realm through arms and lost it through arms. How can one not be cautious—how can one not be cautious!
